# Lore Architect

> > Lore Architect provides in-depth tools, guides, and frameworks for fiction writers to craft sustainable world-building systems and prevent lore decay.

The site offers The Writer's World-Building Guide with methodologies like Lore Layer workflows, lore atoms, and modular documentation approaches. Content is available in English and German (Das Weltenbau-Handbuch), covering narrative structure, character development, and sci-fi worldbuilding techniques.

## Key Topics

- world-building
- fiction-writing
- Lore Layer workflow
- lore decay prevention
- narrative structure
- character development
- lore atoms
- modular documentation
- storytelling frameworks
- sci-fi worldbuilding
- creative writing systems
- weltenbau (German)
- subtext architecture
- top-down vs bottom-up planning
- writing tools and resources

## Core Guides & Framework

- [Lore Architect | Fiction World-Building](https://lorearchitect.com): Homepage for Lore Architect fiction world-building tools and guides
- [About - The Writer's World-Building Guide](https://lorearchitect.com/about): Mission and frameworks for empowering fiction writers with world-building
- [Lore Architect | Weltenbau & Schreiben (German)](https://de.lorearchitect.com): German homepage for Lore Architect world-building and storytelling
- [Über Uns - Das Weltenbau-Handbuch (German)](https://de.lorearchitect.com/ueber-uns): German about page for Das Weltenbau-Handbuch

## World-Building Methodology

- [Sustainable World-Building Habits for a Lore Layer Workflow](https://lorearchitect.com/sustainable-world-building-habits-for-a-lore-layer-workflow): Disciplined Lore Layer workflow to prevent lore drift in world-building
- [Structured World-Building Writing Habits to Prevent Lore Decay](https://lorearchitect.com/structured-world-building-writing-habits-to-prevent-lore-decay): Modular documentation and lore atoms to maintain narrative logic
- [World-Building Prozess zwischen Top-Down Planung und Bottom-Up Entdeckung (German)](https://de.lorearchitect.com/world-building-prozess-zwischen-top-down-planung-und-bottom-up-entdeckung): German article on top-down vs bottom-up world-building approaches
- [Architektur des Verschwiegenen prägt den Subtext im World-Building (German)](https://de.lorearchitect.com/architektur-des-verschwiegenen-praegt-den-subtext-im-world-building): German article on subtext architecture in world-building narrative design

## Resources & Tools

- [Resources / Recommended Tools - The Writer's World-Building Guide](https://lorearchitect.com/resources): Curated tools and software for creative writing and world-building
- [The Writer's World-Building Guide • Content Index](https://lorearchitect.com/content-discovery): Archive of 377 articles on world-building and narrative structure
